scope: NCI-04G source-bound DEVELOPMENT feasibility only; not independently accepted science
code_preexistence: No NCI-04G replacement implementation exists in parent. This preregistration must precede all NCI-04G experiment code and results.
prohibited_after_primary_run: silently reclassifying a true negative as infrastructure failure
resource_acceptance: Record wall/CPU time, peak RSS, resident state and serialized bytes, training observations, prediction calls, intervention calls, rebuild/recovery work, message bytes where relevant. Any deterioration against the exact-parent conventional and native controls is NO-GO, not a hidden optimization trade.
question: Can local cells learn which neighboring information survives loss of function and selectively exchange it to reconstruct an injured function, without copied weights, a global routing oracle, or postlesion target labels?
hypothesis: A local prelesion reliability-dependent message policy can use informative surviving neighbors when the other neighbor is irrelevant, transfer when graph neighborhoods change, and abstain when reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible.
changed_paths: .ice/** (only if source-bound atlas regeneration becomes required)

frozen_design.split: Prelesion observable local observations on bounded 8-cell two-neighbor graphs, with informative left/right position balanced and permuted in unseen heldout graphs. Include one-informative/one-distractor case, redundant-information case, and two-uninformative impossibility case; do not supply hidden labels or global adjacency beyond each cell's immediate neighbors.
frozen_design.ordering: Train policies and equally informed controls only on source-free train seeds; freeze before 16 heldout development seeds and include zero-supervision postlesion sequences. Report all runs.
frozen_design.data_budget: At most 128 prelesion observations per train seed; zero postlesion true target labels; at most 16 synchronous one-hop communication steps per lesion. All observations and message traffic charged equally.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Same prelesion outcome streams, training and prediction budgets for conventional controls. Charge all neighbor message bytes, storage, CPU/RSS and repair steps. No hidden external model calls, global evaluator, copied cell weights, or extra target labels.
frozen_design.capacity: Preserve 8 cells, native LocalGenome K=3,D=7, existing role-state and genome budget of exact-parent LocalTaskRuntime; any additional resident routing parameters must displace—not silently expand—existing learned state. Never weaken damage semantics.
frozen_design.evaluator: Measured correct functional reconstruction for recoverable lesions; strict abstention when both neighbors uninformative; balanced left/right unseen topology transfer; native task snapshot and restart; CPU/RSS/state/message/repair ledger.
frozen_design.source_birth: source-free procedural; exact generator hash, source manifests and evaluation logic must be sealed before any primary evaluation or classify INVALID
frozen_design.comparison_rule: candidate must beat strongest fully trained equal-information conventional local/recurrent control at equal/lower total cost OR match correct decisions with >=10% total CPU reduction and no memory or message-budget regression; no hard false-positive predictions on impossible-information controls.

controls: fully trained local conditional-count predictor with identical observations
fully trained equal-budget local recurrent graph predictor
original NCI-04D2 symmetric neighbor pseudo-target average

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT-FEASIBLE only if >=12/16 recoverable heldout tests succeed when one neighbor alone is informative, zero impossible-information hard false predictions, true postlesion labels=0, each locality restriction proven, learned routing and retained-knowledge ablations each impair recovery, and candidate exceeds strongest fully trained control at equal/lower all-in cost OR equals its decisions with >=10% CPU saving and zero memory/message regression.
classification_rules.mixed: Some necessary conditions met but comparator, transfer, causal ablation, or resource evidence incomplete. No scientific admission.
classification_rules.negative: Valid source/evidence with any required recovery, zero-hard-false-positive, comparator, or CPU/memory/message criterion failed.
classification_rules.invalid: Source or prereg identity drift; local-only restriction broken; postlesion true labels or hidden target oracle used; comparator not trained equally; generator not sealed before outcomes; missing ledger; altered test thresholds or input budgets.

methodological_limits: Eight-cell source-free development feasibility only, not accepted regeneration or general cognition; broader original 16/7/9 architecture and earlier negatives remain preserved.
